datasetKey.description: Unique identifier for the dataset source.

species.description: The scientific name of the recorded species, consistently identified as Capsus ater.

infraspecificEpithet.description: The infraspecific epithet field is entirely empty for all records.

verbatimScientificName.description: The verbatim scientific name of the species Capsus ater.

locality.description: The locality field is entirely empty, containing no recorded data for any of the 1004

occurrenceStatus.description: The occurrence status of Capsus ater, recorded as present for all 1004 observations.

publishingOrgKey.description: Publishing organization identifier formatted as a UUID.

decimalLatitude.description: Decimal latitude coordinates in degrees, ranging from 37.18 to 63.84.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Coordinate uncertainty in meters for species occurrence records.

coordinatePrecision.description: The coordinate precision field is entirely empty across all records.

day.description: Day of the month for species occurrence records, ranging from 1 to 31.

month.description: Integer values representing the month of species occurrence, ranging from 2 to 10.

year.description: Integer values representing the calendar year of species occurrence records.

taxonKey.description: Unique identifier for the taxon Capsus ater.

speciesKey.description: Unique identifier for the species Capsus ater.

basisOfRecord.description: The basis of record for species occurrences, specifically human observations.

institutionCode.description: The institution code identifies the source of the occurrence records.

collectionCode.description: The collection code for all records is Observations.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifiers assigned to each specimen record.

recordNumber.description: A fully null column with no recorded data values.

identifiedBy.description: Identifier of the person who identified the specimen.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time when the specimen was identified.

license.description: License identifiers for the occurrence records, including CC BY, CC BY-NC, and CC0.

rightsHolder.description: Name of the individual or organization holding the rights to the occurrence record.

recordedBy.description: Names of the individuals who recorded the Capsus ater occurrences.

typeStatus.description: This column is entirely empty, containing no recorded data for any records.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of the last data interpretation for each occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media type of occurrence records, primarily still images.
